div.span:
Generate numbered solution
JSON steps + final_answer, T=0

Sample K=5 next-step continuations
given steps 1..i-1, T=0.8, log-probs

Verifier LLM: p_true, rationale,
step type, semantic cluster ids

Consistency = largest cluster share
Semantic entropy = normalised H

Token probability = exp(mean log-prob)
Token entropy

Answer confidence = min over steps
Flagged step = argmin
